app.description: Appointment and customer management for service businesses.
landing.metaTitle: Your business day, all in one place
landing.metaDescription: Manage appointments, customers, staff and business schedules in one configurable workspace. Explore Appointment & Customer Manager.
landing.eyebrow: A workspace for your working day
landing.heroDescription: Manage appointments, customers, staff and business schedules in one place. Less switching between tools. More clarity for the day ahead.
landing.heroNote: One configurable workspace. Different ways to work.
landing.featuresTitle: The details connected. The day in focus.
landing.featuresDescription: Keep the people, services and schedules behind your business together, from the first booking to the next visit.
landing.feature.scheduling.title: A clear appointment calendar
landing.feature.scheduling.description: Find available times, book appointments, reschedule and track their status in day, week or list views.
landing.feature.customers.title: People, beyond the booking
landing.feature.customers.description: Keep contact details and appointment history together. Search, add and update records from one directory.
landing.feature.team.title: Your team and services, aligned
landing.feature.team.description: Manage service durations, prices, staff assignments and working hours alongside your schedule.
landing.feature.configuration.title: A workspace that fits your business
landing.feature.configuration.descriptio: Choose business terminology, time zone, currency and appointment preferences for each workspace.
landing.businessesDescription: The same calendar, contact directory and booking workflow adapt to the way your business works. Your business type sets the terminology and configuration.
landing.business.salon: Bring customers, stylists and services into one schedule, from a quick trim to a longer appointment.
landing.business.clinic: Coordinate appointments, practitioners and basic patient contact details in a scheduling workspace.
landing.business.education: Organize learning sessions, students and instructors with shared availability and appointment history.
landing.business.consulting: Keep client meetings, consultants and professional services connected to the working week.
landing.howEyebrow: A clear path from setup to schedule
landing.step.setup.title: Set up your business
landing.step.setup.description: Choose your business type, language, time zone and working hours.
landing.step.configure.title: Bring your team together
landing.step.configure.description: Add services, set durations and prices, and assign staff with their availability.
landing.step.manage.title: Make room for the day
landing.step.manage.description: Add contacts, find a time and manage appointments from a shared workspace.
landing.finalTitle: Give your working day a clearer view.
landing.finalDescription: Explore a workspace designed around your appointments and the people behind them.
landing.footerNote: Appointments, contacts and business schedules in one place.

public.title: About ACM
public.description: How ACM manages business schedules, accounts and data.
public.productDescription: Appointment & Customer Manager connects scheduling, contact directories, services and staff. Business-specific configuration supports salons, clinics, education and consulting. The interface supports English and Dari.
public.previewDescription: Create an account, verify your email and set up a business. Email sign-in and password reset use the connected account service. Google sign-in is available when configured by the administrator.
public.dataDescription: Business records are saved to the connected database and available only to authorized workspace members. The homepage shows illustrative sample data. Private records are not stored in the service worker cache.
public.offlineDescription: The PWA can cache the application shell. Appointments and changes require a connection; offline writes are rejected and are not queued. Installation support depends on the browser and requires HTTPS in production.
